title: FloorFromLayer Command
description: Create a floor slab from the outermost closed curve on a plan layer. Extrudes downward so the slab top aligns with the 2D plan Z. Default thickness 400. Does not create a roof or ceiling. Layer X-EXIST returns count 0: existing underlay is not a bake source.

layer.description: Source layer for the building outline (case-insensitive). Default wall. CAD floor/roof layers are not used.

thickness.description: Slab thickness in document units (mm). Default 400. Extrudes downward from plan Z.

target_layer.description: Layer for new slabs. Created if missing. Default A-FLOR.

name_prefix.description: Name prefix for new slabs (floor-01, floor-02, …).

join_tolerance.description: Join tolerance for open segments. Default is max(10× model tolerance, 1).

apply_default_materials.description: If true, assign concrete (M-CONCRETE) to the target layer and set objects By Layer. Default true.
